data.name: Iron Graves
data.detailed_description:
YOU ARE THE LAST OPERATOR

IRON GRAVES is a tactical roguelike where you pilot a squad of remote-controlled drones to board and scavenge procedurally generated derelict spaceships.

Stranded in a graveyard of dead ships, your survival depends on fuel, scrap, and unstable technology. From the safety of your shuttle, you guide your drones through breached airlocks into the unknown.

  • Remote Command Interface: Use a pseudo-terminal interface and tactical map to issue commands. Open doors, disable security systems, and override generators.

  • Procedural Derelicts: No two ships are the same. Explore military cruisers, industrial haulers, and research vessels, each with unique layouts and hazards.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Rely on motion sensors and limited camera feeds. The dark is not empty. Monitoring your surroundings is key to avoiding what lurks in the shadows.

  • Permadeath: Once a drone is lost, it's gone forever. If your shuttle runs out of fuel or is destroyed, the game is over.

  • Drone Customization: Scavenge upgrades like motion scanners, towing arms, and mining lasers. Repair and adapt your drone fleet to survive deeper expeditions.

  • Resource Management: Every jump costs fuel. Every breached door risks hull integrity. Manage your resources carefully to reach the next sector alive.

!! MAC USERS: If the game crashes on launch, please check the pinned workaround in the Discussion forum.

data.short_description: Command a squad of salvage drones in deep space. Remotely breach derelict hulls to scavenge for fuel and parts while managing scarce resources. Watch your signal, monitor environmental hazards, and pray your sensors aren't lying. You are alone, and something is moving in the dark.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD FX-6300 or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 / AMD Radeon R5 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Requires Vulkan support.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Catalina 10.15
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Dual Core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 or better (Metal support required)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon (M1/M2) supported via Rosetta 2 or native build.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Big Sur 11.0
  • Processor: Apple M1 Chip / Intel Core i5 (Quad Core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / Radeon Pro 560
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio
  • Additional Notes: Note: During Pre-Alpha, Mac users may need to manually sign the app via Terminal due to Gatekeeper restrictions. See the pinned Discussion thread for a 10-second fix.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer / SteamOS (Holo)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 (Vulkan support required)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan support.
